name: path
title: wsync path
description: Translates between Studio instance paths and syncable filesystem paths using the live Studio tree.
notes: Resolution runs through the project's sync rules, so any instance the middleware maps answers — scripts, value modules, `.model.json`/`.rbxm` subtrees, and `.data.json`-backed instances alike.
Instances outside the projection — not under a mapped root, excluded by `ignoreGlobs`, or inside an `AvoidSync` subtree — are reported as Studio-only instead of being given an invented path.
Generated files such as `wsync.md` are not syncable Studio instances.
